notes.title: Multiplayer - Roll with Friends!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38931008/a337192b8918af1c5b0a4f836915abcdcabb386d.png[/img]

You can now roll with friends! We have added multiplayer as a beta feature, along with one new circuit map.

We hope you will enjoy this update and will post your feedback on our discord and forum. Please let us know what you think about the new feature, and make sure to inform us of any bugs, problems, or things you'd like to see added or changed in the future!

Keep on Rollin'!

notes.title: Multiplayer coming this month!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We are currently in the middle of testing multiplayer features for Rollerballer. Our plan is to release a simple version, where you can race on singleplayer maps with up to 10 friends. Over time our aim is to build on this release, and provide you with new maps, new modes and lots of surprises!

Although there is no exact release date, we are aiming to have everything ready this month. We're already in late stages of development, and we just need to polish up existing code and features.

We hope you will love the new face of Rollerballer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38931008/336e9b1d73a8e9da60a44ecb68b19921fd99703e.png[/img]

notes.title: 1.0c Update
notes.content:
A small update to iron out a couple of things. Changes and fixes:

- Fixed Belarus material not showing up properly
- Extended the boundaries on the first level, to make it a little easier
- Added 2 seconds to each checkpoint on Level 1
- Added 2 seconds to each checkpoint on Level 2
